title: World-Class Tourism
description: Home to Boracay Island — consistently ranked among the world's best beaches — and the Ati-Atihan Festival, one of the Philippines' oldest and most vibrant cultural celebrations.

title: 17 Municipalities
description: Aklan is composed of 17 municipalities: Altavas, Balete, Banga, Batan, Buruanga, Ibajay, Kalibo (capital), Lezo, Libacao, Madalag, Makato, Malay, Malinao, Nabas, New Washington, Numancia, and Tangalan.

title: Rich Agriculture
description: Aklan is a significant agricultural province in Western Visayas, known for coconut, rice, and fisheries production. The Office of the Provincial Agriculturist actively supports farmers and fisherfolk.

title: Accessible Health Care
description: The Provincial Government operates 8 hospitals including DRSTMH (the 300-bed main provincial hospital), ensuring accessible healthcare across all municipalities.

title: Cultural Heritage
description: Aklan is known for its unique Aklanon language, traditional weaving, buri crafts, and a rich cultural heritage that attracts researchers and tourists from around the world.

title: Vision: Progressive & Sustainable
description: The Provincial Government is guided by the vision of a 'Progressive and Sustainable Aklan' — promoting social justice, environmental stewardship, and economic prosperity for all residents.
